translations.web: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
translations.bsb: All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
translations.kjv: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
translations.asv: Every one of them is gone back; they are together become filthy; There is none that doeth good, no, not one.
